The first one: build a credibility filter.

Use the About profile fields to flag risky accounts before they ever reach your shortlist. Accounts with multiple username changes could be recycled or rebranded identities. Recently created accounts with large followings are a red flag. And if someone claims to be a Berlin-based creator but their declared country says something different, that's worth knowing before you invest in a partnership. You can sort and filter all of this in a spreadsheet in minutes.

The second one: automate your vetting pipeline.

Set up an integration with Google Sheets so your scraped data lands there automatically. Then connect that sheet to a tool like n8n, Zapier, or Make to trigger downstream actions. For example, you could build a flow where any profile that scores above a certain credibility threshold - based on account age, verification status, username stability, and location match - automatically gets added to your outreach CRM. Profiles that score below the threshold get flagged for manual review. That turns a manual process into an automated pipeline that runs every time you scrape a new batch of profiles.
